_readme: Each tool is a SLOT fed by a REAL screen recording from a Windows PC (see deliverables/recording-workflow.md). status 'placeholder' renders a labeled schematic. To verify: save the clip in assets/, set file (e.g. assets/power.mp4), source, status 'verified', run python3 build.py. Never mark verified without the real clip. SAFETY: never click Next/Finish in System Restore, never click Restart now in Memory Diagnostic.

win_r.note: Real desktop, press WIN+R, the Run dialog opens.

power.note: Type powercfg.cpl in Run, Enter, Power Options window with plans visible.

reliability.note: perfmon /rel -> Reliability Monitor with stability chart and failure reports.

restore.note: rstrui.exe -> System Restore wizard; CANCEL out, never start a restore.

memdiag.note: mdsched.exe -> Windows Memory Diagnostic dialog; CLOSE it, never click Restart now.
